about: Example datasets built from the SUNDIAL harmonized record. Source: NASA FIRMS (MODIS and VIIRS active fire detections).

files.title: Country-month panel
files.use: Time series, anomaly detection, trend models. The full harmonized record with its raw ingredients.
files.notes: source says which camera carries the month: modis before 2012, snpp (Suomi NPP) after. glued is the uncorrected splice of MODIS and VIIRS.

files.title: Next-month forecast table
files.use: Gradient boosting, neural nets, anything tabular. Train in seconds on a laptop.
files.target: y (or y_log1p): the month's harmonized fire count
files.notes: Every feature uses only months before the target (lags, rolling means, the same calendar month in earlier years), so there is no leakage. split is time-ordered: train to 2019, valid 2020 to 2022, test 2023 on.

files.title: MODIS to VIIRS pairs
files.use: Learn a better harmonizer: raw Terra and Aqua counts and their drifting pass times in, VIIRS counts out.
files.target: suomi_npp_n (what the stable VIIRS camera counted)
files.notes: Months from 2012, when both camera families fly. Pass hours are each satellite's mean daytime local solar time over that country that month. Counts are raw detections, not harmonized.

files.title: World grid, seasonal means
files.use: Spatial models, clustering fire regimes, predicting the burning season from where a cell is.
files.notes: Mean harmonized detections per month, 2012-2025, on a 0.5 degree grid. Cells whose busiest month averages under four detections are left out.

files.title: Daily fire rhythm
files.use: Learn when in the day fires burn, per country, from where each satellite happened to look.
files.notes: Raw detections per local solar half-hour, per satellite, before the drift (2012-2019) and after (2022-2025). Terra and Aqua moved; Suomi NPP did not.

files.title: Country scorecard
files.use: Tiny and instant: predict where the correction works, or where gluing flips the trend.
files.notes: One row per country: calibration slopes, held-out error, how much of Terra's false trend the fix removed, and the glued against fair yearly trend.
